title: Resolving conflicting interface default methods
answer: If two unrelated interfaces provide the same default method signature and a class implements both, the class must resolve the conflict by overriding that method. Inside the override it may choose one implementation explicitly with InterfaceName.super.method(), combine both, or provide completely new behavior.
